name: archguard
description: Architecture drift detection for JavaScript/TypeScript codebases

scripts.build: npm run build -w @archguard/core && npm run build -w @archguard/cli && npm run build -w @archguard/action
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p apps/dashboard --noEmit
